page.overview:
Who is Adolf Hitler?

When Hawkgirl and Hawkman found a magic Egyptian amulet in 1942, they accidentally allowed it to come into the possession of Dirk Strasser, a Nazi soldier.

Hitler encouraged Strasser to use the amulet's mind control properties to magically turn the tides of the war in the Axis' favor.

After the amulet had caused the death of the JSA member Johnny Thunder, the Spectre confiscated the amulet and used it on Hitler to force him to kill himself in 1945. The public was only made aware that Hitler had killed himself, not that the Justice Society was involved.
